Overview

Warm, spicy, and seductively smooth, Extradose Homme by Arabiyat Prestige is an amber-spicy fragrance that blends crisp fruit, creamy vanilla, warm spices, and rich woods.

It opens with apple, cardamom, and black pepper, creating a fresh yet spicy introduction with juicy sweetness and a confident masculine edge.

As it develops, vanilla bean, neroli, and ginger create a warmer and smoother heart. Vanilla adds creamy sweetness, while ginger and neroli keep the fragrance fresh and prevent it from becoming overly heavy.

The dry-down combines tonka bean, amber, sandalwood, and leather, leaving a warm, creamy, slightly leathery trail that feels rich, sensual, and long-lasting.

Inspired by Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Extradose, Extradose Homme delivers that modern sweet-spicy vanilla style with a smooth amber-woody foundation made for evenings and cooler weather.
